name: maxmemory
description: Don't use more memory than the specified amount of bytes. When the memory limit is reached, Redis evicts keys according to the selected maxmemory-policy. 0 disables limit.

name: maxmemory-policy
description: Eviction policy applied when maxmemory is reached (e.g. allkeys-lru or volatile-ttl).

name: maxmemory-samples
description: Number of sample keys inspected to approximate LRU/LFU algorithms. 5 is fast; 10 is near-exact.

name: active-defrag-ignore-bytes
description: Minimum amount of fragmentation waste (in bytes) to activate memory defragmentation.

name: active-defrag-threshold-lower
description: Minimum percentage of fragmentation needed to begin active defragmentation.

name: appendonly
description: Enables the Append Only File (AOF) durability mode providing much higher data safety.

name: appendfsync
description: How often Redis forces the OS kernel to flush AOF writes to disk. 'everysec' is the recommended production compromise.

name: auto-aof-rewrite-percentage
description: Triggers automatic BGREWRITEAOF when the AOF file size grows by this percentage over the base size.

name: auto-aof-rewrite-min-size
description: Minimum file size that the AOF must reach before automatic rewriting can occur.

name: save
description: Snapshot points: 'seconds changes'. Redis saves if both elapsed time and change count criteria are met.

name: rdbcompression
description: Compress string objects using LZF compression when creating RDB snapshots.

name: rdbchecksum
description: Appends a CRC64 checksum at the end of the RDB file to protect against disk corruption.

name: timeout
description: Close connection if client is idle for N seconds (0 to keep connections alive indefinitely).

name: tcp-keepalive
description: Sends TCP ACKs periodically to detect dead peers on long idle sockets.

name: maxclients
description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the multiplexer.

name: slowlog-log-slower-than
description: Execution time threshold in microseconds that logs queries to SLOWLOG. -1 disables.

name: slowlog-max-len
description: Maximum length of the in-memory circular ring buffer holding slow query entries.

name: latency-monitor-threshold
description: Latency monitoring subsystem sampling threshold in milliseconds (0 to disable).

name: requirepass
description: Global server password required to authenticate default user connections. Empty disables global auth.

name: protected-mode
description: Blocks external queries from non-loopback addresses if no password is set and bind is empty.

name: repl-backlog-size
description: Size of the circular ring buffer used for accumulating replication stream bytes for PSYNC.

name: repl-backlog-ttl
description: Number of seconds after all replicas disconnect before releasing the backlog buffer memory.

name: repl-ping-replica-period
description: How often replicas send PING heartbeats to the primary master.

name: repl-timeout
description: Replication communication timeout in seconds (bulk transfer I/O and heartbeat detection).

name: replica-read-only
description: Forces replica instances to reject client write commands to preserve primary synchronization.

name: hash-max-listpack-entries
description: Hashes are encoded using a memory-optimized listpack when they have up to this many fields.

name: hash-max-listpack-value
description: Maximum size in bytes of individual values in a hash before upgrading from listpack to hashtable.

name: zset-max-listpack-entries
description: Sorted sets are encoded with compact listpacks until exceeding this number of members.

name: zset-max-listpack-value
description: Maximum byte size of a sorted set member before upgrading from listpack to skiplist.

name: databases
description: Number of logical databases configured on the server. Indexed 0 to N-1.

name: port
description: TCP port on which Redis listens for client connections (default 6379).
